# 2 Chronicles Chapter 14 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-he-lay-down Abijah with his-fathers and-they-buried-him in-city-of David and-he-reigned Asa his-son in-his-place in-his-days the-land was-quiet ten years.

**2** And-he-did Asa the-good and-the-right in-eyes-of YHWH his-God.

**3** And-he-removed the-altars-of the-foreign and-the-high-places and-he-broke the-pillars and-he-cut-down the-Asherim.

**4** And-he-said to-Judah to-seek YHWH God-of their-fathers and-to-do the-law and-the-commandment.

**5** And-he-removed from-all cities-of Judah the-high-places and-the-incense-altars and-the-kingdom was-quiet before-him.

**6** And-he-built cities-of fortification in-Judah for quiet was the-land and-none with-him war in-the-years these for gave-rest to-him YHWH.

**7** And-he-said to-Judah let-us-build these cities and-surround with-walls and-towers gates and-bars still the-land is-before-us for we-sought YHWH our-God we-sought and-He-gave-rest to-us from-all-around and-they-built and-they-prospered.

**8** And-there-was to-Asa an-army bearing shields and-spears from-Judah three-hundred thousand and-from-Benjamin bearing-shields and-drawing-bows two-hundred-and-eighty thousand all-these mighty-men-of valor.

**9** And-he-came-out against-them Zerah the-Cushite with-an-army-of a-thousand thousands and-chariots three-hundred and-he-came to-Mareshah.

**10** And-he-went-out Asa before-him and-they-set-battle in-valley-of Zephathah at-Mareshah.

**11** And-he-called Asa to YHWH his-God and-he-said YHWH there-is-none with-You to-help between the-many to-the-one-without strength help-us YHWH our-God for on-You we-lean and-in-Your-name we-come against this multitude YHWH our-God You are do-not let-prevail against-You mortal-man.

**12** And-He-struck YHWH the-Cushites before Asa and-before Judah and-they-fled the-Cushites.

**13** And-he-pursued-them Asa and-the-people who were-with-him to-Gerar and-they-fell from-the-Cushites until-none for-them alive for they-were-broken before YHWH and-before His-camp and-they-carried plunder great very.

**14** And-they-struck all the-cities around Gerar for was fear-of YHWH upon-them and-they-plundered all the-cities for much plunder was in-them.

**15** And-also tents-of cattle they-struck and-they-captured sheep for-abundance and-camels and-they-returned to-Jerusalem.


---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **14:7**: we-sought YHWH...He-gave-rest — The cause-and-effect is explicit: seeking God produces national security. The Chronicler's theology of rest echoes the Deuteronomic promise.

- **14:11**: between the-many to-the-one-without strength — Asa's prayer articulates the Chronicler's core conviction: God equalizes all odds. Numbers are irrelevant when YHWH fights.

- **14:12**: before YHWH and-before His-camp — The divine army fights alongside Judah. The victory is supernatural, not merely military.


— EMET
